title: Java Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Java Engineer (3- 6 years' experience) in Bangalore/Gurgaon to drive modernisation of enterprise financial platforms. You will lead cloud migration (AWS), integrate AI, and develop high-performance backend systems focusing on cleared derivatives, risk management, and margin optimisation.


Responsibilities:

  • Backend Development: Build high-performance, low-latency services using Java 8/11/17+ and Spring Boot.
  • Cloud Migration: Execute on-premises to AWS cloud migration initiatives.
  • Derivatives Focus: Implement complex business logic for cleared derivatives, covering trade matching and regulatory reporting.
  • AI Integration: Implement AI pipelines for automated financial data processing.
  • Architecture: Utilise AWS services (Lambda, ECS, S3 RDS, Kafka).


Requirements:

  • Domain expertise in Cleared Derivatives (Futures & Options, Clearing Houses).
  • Experience designing scalable microservices.
  • Experience with Generative AI or Agent builders.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.


Required Technical Skills:

  • Java and Spring: Advanced Core Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate.
  • AWS: Strong experience in AWS cloud infrastructure and security.
  • Databases: Expert-level SQL (Oracle/PostgreSQL).
  • DevOps: Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and migration patterns.
